howto.what: 当询问Flutter项目结构、分层架构或功能模块时，Claude会按feature-first原则组织代码：按功能分组文件，分层为UI、Data、可选Logic层，并强调单向数据流。
howto.when: 当被问到如何组织Flutter项目、创建新功能、添加Repository/Service/ViewModel、或决定业务逻辑归属时触发。

say.text: 帮我把当前项目重构为feature-first结构。
say.note: Claude会输出新的目录结构和迁移步骤。

say.text: 我要给用户模块添加登录用例，请按架构步骤实现。

howto.what_en: When asked about Flutter project structure, layers, or features, Claude will organize code by feature-first principle: group files by feature, separate into UI, Data, optional Logic layers, and enforce unidirectional data flow.
howto.when_en: Triggered when asked how to structure a Flutter project, create a new feature, add Repository/Service/ViewModel, or decide which layer owns logic.

say_en.text: Refactor my current project to feature-first structure.
say_en.note: Claude outputs new directory structure and migration steps.

say_en.text: Add login use case for the user module following architecture steps.
